```{r}
folder <- "../../../Lana/2024_12_29_17_15/OEE-data"

files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "^SummaryIndividuals_\\d+_with_clusters.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
nums  <- as.integer(sub(".*_(\\d+)\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(files)))
files <- files[order(nums, na.last = TRUE)]

# check structure

plot_one_cluster_file <- function(csv_path) {
df <- read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = factor(cluster_id))) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = basename(csv_path),
    color = "cluster_id",
    x = "x",
    y = "y"
  )

return(p)
}
    
```


```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(purrr)
library(htmltools)

folder <- "../../../Lana/2024_12_29_17_15/OEE-data"

files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "^SummaryIndividuals_\\d+_with_clusters.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
nums  <- as.integer(sub(".*_(\\d+)\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(files)))
files <- files[order(nums, na.last = TRUE)]

# function: read one csv and build a plotly scatter plot
make_plot_div <- function(csv_path) {
  df <- read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # basic interactive scatter, colored by cluster_id
  plt <- plot_ly(
    df,
    x = ~x,
    y = ~y,
    color = ~as.factor(cluster_id),
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.7)
  ) %>%
    layout(
      title = list(text = basename(csv_path)),
      xaxis = list(title = "x"),
      yaxis = list(title = "y"),
      legend = list(title = list(text = "cluster_id"))
    )

  # wrap in a <div> so we can stack them later
  div(
    style = "margin-bottom:40px;",
    plt
  )
}

# build a list of <div> blocks, one per timestep
plot_divs <- map(files, make_plot_div)

# assemble full page
page <- browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$html(
      tags<head>(
        tags$title("Species Clusters by Timestep")
      ),
      tags$body(
        h2("Species Clusters (per 5000 steps)"),
        plot_divs
      )
    )
  )
)

# save as a single self-contained html file
saveWidget(
  widget = page,
  file = out_html,
  selfcontained = TRUE
)

```
